_comment: Per-package coverage floors (TP-10). scripts/lint/coverage_ratchet.py fails a PR whose measured coverage is below a floor, or that lowers a floor already on the base branch. Raising floors is a manual 'measure' then 'update' run, never automatic in CI. 'target' is the plan's goal (test-plan-2026-09.md 4.1) and does not gate.
reason: Initial floors: Linux CI measured baseline (PR #26, run 36611881385: scripts/ai 56.89%, tasks 19.63%; branch mode, whole gate), rounded down to one decimal. Raised at TP-10's merge to scripts/ai 57.1 / tasks 22.7. TP-10b (tests for the untested gate scripts, PR #43) raised them to the Linux CI measurement of that PR's coverage job (run 36667064255: scripts/ai 83.86%, tasks 23.72%), rounded down. To justify lowering a floor, add a line that starts with the marker documented in scripts/lint/coverage_ratchet.py, followed by the reason.
